headline: /BQ25185_STAT1 ROUTES TO U2.9 IN 26.128 mm AND CANNOT BE PROMOTED, BECAUSE THE CORRIDOR INTO U2's THREE ADJACENT PINS ADMITS EXACTLY ONE CONDUCTOR.  AND D-702/D-703's WHOLE ACC_5V FRAMING IS REFUTED: U21.4's GROUND WAS NEVER A FILL GAP OR A BARREL, IT WAS THE BOARD'S OWN SYS POUR.

1_STAT1_routes_and_the_wall_is_a_FANOUT.route: /BQ25185_STAT1 U11.9 -> U2.9, 26.128 mm, 3 barrels, B -> In2 -> F -> B; reproduced in runs b1 and b6
1_STAT1_routes_and_the_wall_is_a_FANOUT.the_unique_opener: screen_pair_corridor_blame swept all 41 window nets ONE AT A TIME and exactly ONE opens the corridor: /SD_CARD_DETECT_N, at 31.313 mm / 2 vias (Q1's upper bound with every net dropped is 21.257 mm at ZERO vias)
1_STAT1_routes_and_the_wall_is_a_FANOUT.why_it_is_not_promotable: U2.9, U2.10 and U2.11 are THREE ADJACENT PCAL9535A pins in one column at x 54.138, and the corridor feeding them admits ONE conductor.  It belongs to /SD_CARD_DETECT_N.
six_gate_runs_that_prove_the_trade: b1  wide window, STAT1 first  -> STAT1 26.128 mm OK, /SD_CARD_DETECT_N NO_PATH, one track_dangling
b4  narrow window, SD first   -> SD 73.680 mm OK, STAT1 NO_PATH
b5  narrow + 12 mm tap        -> STAT1 NO_PATH (the RETAINED U2.11 B.Cu stub is what blocks it), SD 73.680 mm OK
b6  window tuned to leave a 9.9 mm tap stub -> STAT1 26.128 mm OK, SD NO_PATH, and its TAP WAS ASKED THREE TIMES and answered NO_PATH at 0.200 mm -- so the refusal is not a --tap-max-mm artefact
b7  wide window, SD first     -> SD 78.816 mm OK with DRC CLEAN and nets_regressed [], and STAT1 STILL NO_PATH: SD's long way round uses the same channel
a1  no eviction at all        -> both NO_PATH
1_STAT1_routes_and_the_wall_is_a_FANOUT.conclusion: this is a FAN-OUT problem at U2, not a corridor search.  The transaction that closes it is a re-floorplan of the U2 pin neighbourhood, and it would close /BQ25185_STAT1 AND /BQ25185_STAT2 together -- THREE of the fifteen edges.

2_STAT2_is_the_same_lane.U11.3_leg: minimal cut {/01_POWER_TREE/BAT_PROTECTED_P, /SD_CARD_DETECT_N, /WAKE_INT_N, GND} at 135.526 mm / 10 vias -- and BAT_PROTECTED_P is PROTECTED copper with no authorization covering it
2_STAT2_is_the_same_lane.TP7.1_leg: minimal cut {/NFC_5V_EN, /TOUCH_RST_N} -- only TWO nets, and the corridor then opens at 177.521 mm / 11 vias against a Q1 upper bound of 17.865 mm at ZERO vias.  The reverse-greedy minimises NETS, not LENGTH; a two-net cut that costs 177 mm is not a transaction.
2_STAT2_is_the_same_lane.reading: both legs are the same one-conductor lane into U2's east side

3_ACC_5V_LX_D702_AND_D703_ARE_REFUTED_AN.what_was_believed: D-702(a): U21.4 has no ground because the B GND fill must stay 0.250 mm off U21.5's land corner and so cannot start before x 58.959 while U21.4's land ends at 58.850 -- a 0.109 mm gap -- so the 6.3 mm GND chain IS the converter's return and the land wants a bond barrel.  D-703 then spent FIVE gate runs (r14-r18) on that barrel and closed at a 0.025 mm bond-escape-versus-LX-neck conflict.
3_ACC_5V_LX_D702_AND_D703_ARE_REFUTED_AN.what_is_measured: the blocker was never the fill gap and never the barrel.  It was the board's OWN `B /01_POWER_TREE/BQ25185_SYS POUR 2`.  Pull its east edge 60.000 -> 58.400 and B.Cu GND floods the pocket and reaches U21.4 DIRECTLY.
3_ACC_5V_LX_D702_AND_D703_ARE_REFUTED_AN.PROOF: evidence/d710-build-boost-base.sh rebuilds it in one command -- pour narrowed, C65 +0.300 mm east, and the 6.3 mm GND chain REMOVED -- and real refilled KiCad DRC is {solder_mask_bridge: 1, lib_footprint_issues: 199} with 31 unconnected items, and routing_ledger reports EXACTLY the authority's 15 retained open edges over the same 10 nets.  GND is not regressed.  There is no peninsula, no bond barrel, and D-703's 0.025 mm conflict does not arise at all.
3_ACC_5V_LX_D702_AND_D703_ARE_REFUTED_AN.the_real_wall_and_its_arithmetic: U21.5 itself.  QBoard.escape casts its ray from the PAD CENTRE, so the escape is a TRACK down the land's spine and owes the full routed clearance to the flanking lands -- verify_laid says so in its own docstring and names U21.4 as one of the three pads that taught it.  The distance is ALWAYS 0.325 mm (0.175 mm land half-height + the 0.150 mm inter-land gap of a 0.500 mm-pitch SOT-563) and the requirement is w/2 + 0.200, so w <= 0.250 mm.  And the FIRST POINT east of U21.4 where a 0.400 mm SWITCH_NODE trunk can legally exist is x = 59.083 -- sqrt(0.400^2 - 0.325^2) = 0.2332 mm past U21.4's corner -- while U21's courtyard, where the .kicad_dru already licenses a 0.200 mm neck, ends at x = 59.000.  EIGHTY-THREE MICRONS.
3_ACC_5V_LX_D702_AND_D703_ARE_REFUTED_AN.the_trials_are_published: evidence/d710-u21-escape-trials.json -- all 96 escape trials with the obstacle each meets, the distance it has and the distance it owes.  ZERO are free.
four_remedies_built_and_refused: C65 further east: at +0.300 the 0.400 mm trial is short 0.0072 mm against C65.1 -- SEVEN MICRONS -- and at +0.500 C65 is clear and U21.4 becomes the binding blocker at 0.075 mm.  So C65 is a real but NOT the last constraint.

extend U21.5's SW land east 0.675 -> 1.425 mm (standard boost-converter practice): NO EFFECT, because the escape ray still starts at the PAD CENTRE and runs down the spine whatever the land's shape is
widen U21's courtyard to IPC nominal, centreline x 59.000 -> 59.150, so the board's own 0.200 mm necking licence reaches the first legal trunk point: pad_escapes still returns ZERO
evict /01_POWER_TREE/ACC_5V_RAW whole: re-laid at 137.851 mm / 8 vias, GND regressed, pour_partition REFUSED, and U21.5 still sealed
3_ACC_5V_LX_D702_AND_D703_ARE_REFUTED_AN.and_the_width_that_would_fit_is_refused_: the .kicad_dru's own section 5 publishes a 2.19 A PEAK INDUCTOR CURRENT for this boost (D-185).  A 0.200 mm trace at this board's copper carries 0.742 A at dT = 10 K.  A PAD_ESCAPE_RUN_U21_5 width licence at 0.200 mm would be a knowing derating of the accessory 5 V switch node, and it is NOT taken.
3_ACC_5V_LX_D702_AND_D703_ARE_REFUTED_AN.consequence: ACC_5V_LX -- and with it the switched 5 V accessory supply, a RETAINED Demo feature -- is now a PACKAGE question, which is exactly D-703 option 4 (cc9f356), already owner-authorized: U21 is a TPS61023 in SOT-563 whose middle land cannot pass its own trunk.

4_what_this_leaves_on_disk.boost_base: evidence/d710-build-boost-base.sh -- reproducible, DRC-clean, ledger-identical; it is the base every later ACC_5V transaction should start from
4_what_this_leaves_on_disk.instruments: evidence/d710-u21-escape-trials.py prints the ARITHMETIC of every QBoard.escape trial for a land instead of the histogram the gate prints; evidence/d710-strip-objects.py removes NAMED objects by exact signature and reports each one

5_next_highest_leverage: RE-FLOORPLAN THE U2 PIN NEIGHBOURHOOD.  /BQ25185_STAT1 (U2.9), /BQ25185_STAT2 (U2.10) and /SD_CARD_DETECT_N (U2.11) are three adjacent pins sharing one conductor's worth of corridor.  Three of the fifteen remaining edges are behind it and STAT1's route is already measured at 26.128 mm.
U21 PACKAGE SUBSTITUTION under D-703 option 4 -- the SOT-563's middle land cannot pass a 0.400 mm trunk at ANY placement, and the switched 5 V accessory rail depends on it.

/01_POWER_TREE/BQ25185_SYS is still the largest single open net at FIVE edges, and D-706 measured that U11.1 and C27.1 are cut off by the BAT_PROTECTED_P hand taper that D-708 named -- a TAPERED-TRUNK primitive remains the one lever that unlocks U11.
